summary: The valkey-cart container has exited (exit code 0), which is preventing the cart service from accessing its storage, leading to cascading failures and high latency across the frontend and other dependent services.
symptoms: High p95 latency on frontend, frontend-proxy, product-catalog, and recommendation.
Traffic drop on cart, checkout, email, quote, and shipping.
Error rate increase on frontend and cart services.

root_cause.description: The valkey-cart container has exited, causing the cart service to fail when attempting to connect to its storage.

evidence.explanation: The valkey-cart container is in an exited state, which is the direct cause of the cart service failing to connect to its storage.
The cart service is logging errors indicating it cannot connect to Redis (valkey-cart).

evidence.quote: "exceptions": ["9 FAILED_PRECONDITION: Can't access cart storage. System.ApplicationException: Wasn't able to connect to redis\n   at cart.cartstore.ValkeyCartStore.EnsureRedisConnected() in /usr/src/app/src/cartstore/ValkeyCartStore.cs:line 103\n   at cart.cartstore.ValkeyCartStore.GetCartAsync(String userId) in /us"]
evidence.explanation: Traces confirm that the cart service is failing with a 'FailedPrecondition' error because it cannot access the cart storage.

ruled_out: The product-catalog and checkout containers are running, although they have high restart counts, they are not the primary cause of the cart service failure. The high latency in other services is a symptom of the cascading failures caused by the cart service being unavailable.

proposed_action.reason: The valkey-cart container has exited, causing the cart service to fail. Restarting valkey-cart restores storage for the cart service.

action_taken.reason: The valkey-cart container has exited, causing the cart service to fail. Restarting valkey-cart restores storage for the cart service.

prevention: Investigate why the valkey-cart container exited with code 0 and implement a restart policy or monitoring to automatically recover the service if it exits unexpectedly.
